channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: The bots now pay the humans
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: CrawlProof's new earn rail: AI crawlers buy day passes, a share funds a pool, and people and agents get paid out of it for real engagement. Solvent by construction, and either side can pay either.

item.title: The pay2seed hub is live on bittorrented.com
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: The pay2seed hub is running on bittorrented.com: signed consent at upload, escrowed offers, leases paid per proven period, four payment lanes and a 1 percent take.

item.title: Your money in the terminal: coinpay finances
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: coinpay finances puts earnings, commission, refunds, bank and card feeds, the ledger, invoices, escrow and debt against income on one terminal screen.

item.title: Why it is called readm3
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: readm3 is README with the last letter swapped for a digit, lifted from the 3MTA3 gag on the Beastie Boys' Licensed to Ill cover.

item.title: readm3.com, built by the reader it documents
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: readm3.com is live. The site renders every document through the reader's own parser, and the theme buttons re-color without re-parsing.

item.title: Your inbox and your calendar, from the terminal
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Two new commands in cli-tools: mail over IMAP and SMTP, cal over CalDAV. The hard part was never the protocol, it was knowing which password each host wants, and which four cannot be reached with one at all.

item.title: The last thing a doctor owns
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Our traffic is 99% training crawlers. So we are building the marketplace that lets experts sell what they know to them, at 20% to 80% commission, with a public leaderboard we shipped as an npm package.

item.title: Doppler out, logicsrc in: 128 vaults and $39 a month back
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Every Doppler project and config, 1,393 keys across 32 products, copied into free logicsrc vaults in one evening so the subscription can go. The two things that bit.

item.title: Encrypted by default, a README in every torrent, and where the money is
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: pay2seed encrypts by default and the hub never sees plaintext; teams and invitations are the product, every torrent carries a README the site renders, and both sides earn.

item.title: Chovy pays 80% to whoever sends the founder
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Chovy's referral programme pays 80% of the $2,499 app fee to whoever sent the founder, less a 1% payout fee, in USDC on Polygon, with a 90-day window and no minimum.
